summary:
## Standing operator rules:
Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.
Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.
Keep commits small so review stays easy.
The active schema is `billing_v3`; never seed or write into frozen `billing_v1` (superseded as active schema).

## Current objective:
Fix the intermittent invoice-sync `409 Conflict` race. Reconciliation refund double-counting remains pending.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace `payments`; image `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; schema `billing_v3`; endpoint `/v1/invoices/INV-1042/sync`; expected `202`, observed `409`. Canary deployment used `2.8.0-rc.2` (superseded deployment image).

## Ruled-out approaches:
Index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)`—doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress:
Invoice-sync race diagnosis: done; fix: pending. Next: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/services/invoice_sync.py`.

## Recent work:
Full suite passed 318 tests, 4 skipped, in 14.92s. Repeated integration test reproduced one conflict in 20 concurrent runs; `InvoiceSyncService.submit` forwards keys but does not persist completed responses.
